maddeler.e:
أستنصر (form X)
# أَسْتَنْصِرُ (ʔastanṣiru) /ʔas.tan.sˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# أُسْتَنْصَرُ (ʔustanṣaru) /ʔus.tan.sˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# أَسْتَنْصِرَ (ʔastanṣira) /ʔas.tan.sˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# أُسْتَنْصَر
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
